lines.sub: Hi! This is Lira's Academy, lesson eighteen — “Notes and memory”.
lines.tts: Hi! This is Lira's Academy, lesson eighteen — Notes and memory.

lines.sub: Your son's shoe size, the intercom code, a gift idea — it's hard to keep it all in your head.
lines.tts: Your son's shoe size, the intercom code, a gift idea — it's hard to keep it all in your head.

lines.sub: Say: “Remember: Dima's shoe size is thirty-two.” Ask later — I'll answer.
lines.tts: Say: Remember: Dima's shoe size is thirty-two. Ask later — I'll answer.

lines.sub: Longer things go to notes: “Write a note: vacation ideas.” With tags, colours and pictures.
lines.tts: Longer things go to notes: Write a note: vacation ideas. With tags, colours and pictures.

lines.sub: Don't remember where you wrote it? “What did I write about the vacation?” — I'll find it in notes, the diary and documents.
lines.tts: Don't remember where you wrote it? What did I write about the vacation? — I'll find it in notes, the diary and documents.

lines.sub: And in “Memory” everything is shown as a map: what I know about you and how one thing connects to another.
lines.tts: And in Memory everything is shown as a map: what I know about you and how one thing connects to another.

lines.sub: Ask: “What do you know about me?” — and correct me if something's wrong.
